registry_info.description: The Unit: robots with three actions - drive, turn the chassis, turn a hub - and what two of them become when a rod joins them.

the_unit.name: The Unit
the_unit.description: A small robot with exactly three controllable actions: move forward or back, turn its chassis, turn an independent hub that carries a pin. One unit with a pen on the pin draws a closed four-loop rosette. Two identical units joined hub pin to hub pin by a 1 m rod, each keeping its own drive and giving way to the force at its own pin (what a back-drivable motor does), are pulled into one relation neither programme contains: within a minute three different starts hold one distance and angle, both units turning at about a third of their programmed rate, and the pen on the rod draws a slow wavy spiral. Three units in a triangle of rods (a tighter programme, w0 0.8) end in one relation from nine of eleven starts, their pens weaving a spirograph ring. This is mechanical self-organisation (level 2 of Palle's three), not units that adapt (level 3). setup pair | triangle | apart (the control: same units, same starts, no rod) | one. The model and the rule: unit_sim.gd. Bench: commons/testing/probe_the_unit.tscn.
